name: Text to Video
description: Text to Video is an overview page: browse 28 video models and example prompts, then open Video Studio with your pick filled in.
shortDescription: Pick a video model or example prompt, then create the clip in Video Studio.
fullDescription: Text to Video (#/text-to-video) is a starting page, not a generator. It has four 'Video Generation Reimagined' highlight cards, a 'Ready to Create Videos?' section with 'Get Started Free' and '🎯 GTM Boost', an 'Available Models' grid of 28 model cards, five 'Example Prompts' with 'Try this →', and a 'Start Creating Now' section with 'Start Creating Videos'. There is no prompt box, duration, ratio or Generate button here: everything opens Video Studio (#/video). A model card opens Video Studio with that model selected when Video Studio has a text-to-video model with the same name; an example also puts its prompt into Video Studio's prompt box.
bestFor: New users who want to see the video models and start from an example prompt before opening Video Studio.
whenToUse: You want to browse video models (Kling, Sora, Veo, Seedance, Wan, Hailuo, Runway, Pixverse...) by name.
You want an example video prompt filled into Video Studio.
You want GTM Boost to write a marketing video prompt.
whenToUseAnother: Use Video Studio (#/video) directly when you know what to write.
Use Image to Video (#/image-to-video) or Video Studio with a start frame when you want to animate a picture.
Use Text to Image (#/text-to-image) for a still image.
keyFeatures: 'Get Started Free' and 'Start Creating Videos' buttons that open Video Studio.
'Available Models' grid of 28 model cards; a click pre-selects the model in Video Studio when the name matches.
'Example Prompts' with 'Try this →' that fill Video Studio's prompt box.
'🎯 GTM Boost' prompt helper whose result goes to Video Studio.

featureExplanations.explanation: Four information cards: 'Cinematic Quality', '40+ Models', 'Multiple Durations' and 'HD & 4K Support'. They are not buttons.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Summary of what Video Studio offers.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Marketing text: the page grid lists 28 models. Durations and resolutions depend on the model you choose in Video Studio.

featureExplanations.explanation: In 'Ready to Create Videos?', 'Get Started Free' opens Video Studio (#/video).
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Fastest way to the video generator.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Nothing is generated on this page.

featureExplanations.explanation: The '🎯 GTM Boost' button opens the GTM Boost window ('🎯 GTM Boost · Text to Video'). You write your idea, pick an angle, audience and goal, and click the Boost button to get a conversion-focused prompt. 'Apply' closes the window and opens Video Studio with that prompt already in the prompt box.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Turn a rough marketing idea into a ready-to-use prompt before you start.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: An idea in step 1 (otherwise the window says 'Add your ... idea first.').
featureExplanations.restrictions: Without an OpenAI key the window shows 'Add your OpenAI key for AI-written results. Until then GTM Boost uses a built-in template.'

featureExplanations.explanation: A grid of 28 model cards ('Choose from 28 powerful video generation models') with name, family badge and description. Clicking a card opens Video Studio and pre-selects that model when Video Studio has a text-to-video model with the same name.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Start Video Studio on a specific model.
featureExplanations.restrictions: No exact match, so Video Studio opens on its default (Seedance Lite): Kling v2.1, Kling v2.5, Kling v2.6, Kling v3.0, Seedance v1.5, Seedance v2.0, Hailuo 02 and Hailuo 2.3. Check the model button in Video Studio.

featureExplanations.explanation: Five example cards with a model badge and 'Try this →' (for example 'A drone shot flying over a futuristic city at sunset...' with Kling v2.1). Clicking one opens Video Studio with the prompt in the prompt box and the model selected when it matches.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Start from a working video prompt.
featureExplanations.restrictions: The Kling v2.1 example's model has no exact match, so only its prompt carries over. You still click Generate in Video Studio.

featureExplanations.explanation: In 'Start Creating Now' ('Pick a model or try an example prompt to begin'), 'Start Creating Videos' opens Video Studio.

howToUse: 1. Open Text to Video (#/text-to-video). 2. Click a model card, an example prompt / 'Try this →', or 'Get Started Free' / 'Start Creating Videos'. 3. Video Studio opens; check the model button and prompt. 4. Set ratio, duration and other options and click Generate in Video Studio.
howToSteps: Click a model card, an example, or a start button.
In Video Studio, check model and prompt.
Set aspect ratio and duration in Video Studio.
gettingStarted: Click 'Try this →' on the Veo 3 flower timelapse example.
Review the prompt in Video Studio and click Generate there.
requiredInputs: None on this page (it only opens Video Studio).

inputDetails.name: Model card
inputDetails.description: One of 28 model names passed to Video Studio.
inputDetails.whenToUse: To start on a specific model.
inputDetails.restrictions: No match (Video Studio uses Seedance Lite): Kling v2.1, Kling v2.5, Kling v2.6, Kling v3.0, Seedance v1.5, Seedance v2.0, Hailuo 02 and Hailuo 2.3.

inputDetails.name: Example prompt
inputDetails.description: One of five ready prompts placed in Video Studio's prompt box.
inputDetails.restrictions: Edit it in Video Studio before generating.

generationModes: None on this page (generation happens in Video Studio)

modeExplanations.description: Every control opens Video Studio, optionally with a model and/or prompt filled in.
modeExplanations.useCase: Pick a starting point, then generate in Video Studio.

modelCapabilities: The page lists 28 names: Kling v2.1/v2.5/v2.6/v3.0, Sora, Sora 2, Veo 3, Veo 3.1, Seedance Lite/Pro/v1.5/v2.0, Seedance 2.0 Extend, Wan 2.1/2.2/2.5/2.6, Hunyuan, Hailuo 02/2.3, Runway Gen-3, Pixverse v4.5/v5/v5.5, Vidu v2.0, LTX 2 Pro, OVI and Grok Imagine. 20 of them match a model in Video Studio's text-to-video list (115 models).
outputs: No output on this page; it opens Video Studio, optionally with model and prompt filled in.
limitations: No prompt box, duration, ratio or Generate button here.
8 of 28 model cards do not match a Video Studio model.
Highlight-card claims ('40+ Models', 'up to 4K', 'seconds to minutes') are general marketing text.

limitationDetails.limitation: Some model cards are not pre-selected
limitationDetails.impact: Video Studio opens on Seedance Lite.
limitationDetails.workaround: Pick the model with Video Studio's model button.

troubleshooting: Video Studio shows Seedance Lite instead of my Kling card: that card name has no exact match; pick the Kling model in Video Studio's picker.

steps: Open the model picker in Video Studio.

commonProblems.problem: Clicking a card did not make a video
commonProblems.whyItHappens: This page only opens Video Studio.

exampleWorkflows.title: Clip from an example prompt
steps: Click 'Try this →' on the Sora wave example.
Video Studio opens with the prompt and Sora selected.

useCases.title: Exploring video models
useCases.description: See model names and families, then start Video Studio on one.
useCases.expectedOutput: Video Studio opened on the chosen model (when the name matches).

faqs.question: Can I generate directly on this page?
faqs.answer: No. This page has no prompt box, upload, ratio or Generate button. Every button and card opens Video Studio (#/video), where the actual generation happens.

glossary.Prompt: The text you write to describe the video.
glossary.Model: The AI engine that makes the clip; each one has its own durations, ratios and options.
glossary.Prefill: When this page passes a prompt or model to Video Studio so it is already filled in.
glossary.GTM Boost: A helper window that rewrites your idea as a marketing-focused video prompt.

tips: Use an example prompt as a template.
Check Video Studio's model button after clicking a model card.
bestPractices: Treat this page as a menu; set duration and ratio in Video Studio.
